fleet.name: Whale-watching boats
fleet.description: Boats of the Pacific Whale Watch Association member companies, tied to each company by an official record (docs/WHALE_WATCH_FLEET.md).

readme: Starting list for scripts/ships/import-fleet.mjs. Each boat resolves to an EarthAtlas vessel by its MMSI at "at". Later additions go straight to the database (import-fleet --add); this file is not the live list. A member with vessel_id is taken as that vessel directly (used where the MMSI lookup at a single time finds no vessel).
